positioning.onePrivateCockpitForAllYour: One private cockpit for all your engineering context.
positioning.stopJumpingAcrossDozensOfBrowser: Stop jumping across dozens of browser tabs. Unify remote tickets, local tasks, PR code reviews, calendar meetings, and time logs into one single dashboard — with 100% of your data saved securely on your computer.
positioning.consolidateIssuesFromJiraRedmineAnd: Consolidate issues from Jira, Redmine, and YouTrack alongside your own private local to-do items without switching windows.
positioning.linkGithubAndGitlabPullRequests: Link GitHub and GitLab Pull Requests directly to active work items and track review effort and branch activity with precision.
positioning.importScheduledMeetingsAndDailyCalendar: Import scheduled meetings and daily calendar events to convert meeting hours into logged time entries in a single click.
positioning.weDonTAddBloatOr: We don't add bloat or replace your team's source of truth
positioning.notAReplacementForYourIssue: Not a replacement for your issue tracker:
positioning.yourTeamKeepsUsingJiraRedmine: Your team keeps using Jira, Redmine, or GitHub as the source of truth.
positioning.notAHeavySlowWebApp: Not a heavy, slow web app:
positioning.noEndlessLoadingSpinnersOrBrowser: No endless loading spinners or browser tabs eating up your RAM while you write code.
positioning.zeroEmployeeMonitoringZeroKeystrokeLoggi: Zero employee monitoring, zero keystroke logging, and zero data sent to third-party telemetry servers.
positioning.zeroClutterZeroFriction100Focused: Zero clutter · Zero friction · 100% focused on execution
positioning.localFirstExecutionAndUnifiedWorkflow: Local-first execution and unified workflow cockpit
positioning.everythingIsSavedLocallyOnYour: Everything is saved locally on your computer. Unify Jira & Redmine issues, private local tasks, meetings, and time entries in one single, responsive dashboard.
positioning.fetchAssignedTicketsAndPushTime: Fetch assigned tickets and push time logs automatically back to your company's trackers without breaking your flow state.
positioning.measureUninterruptedCodingBlocksTrackCon: Measure uninterrupted coding blocks, track context switches, and gain clear visibility into your technical day.
positioning.localFirstOpenCoreBuiltWith: Local-First · Open Core · Built with TypeScript & React

integrations.queryTicketsUpdateIssueStatusAnd: Query tickets, update issue status, and push work logs directly without opening bloated browser tabs.
integrations.fullBiDirectionalSyncForTime: Full bi-directional sync for time entries, custom activities, and percentage completion via official REST API.
integrations.linkCommitsBranchesAndPullRequests: Link commits, branches, and Pull Requests to your active time entries and issues seamlessly.
integrations.manageSprintsWorkItemsAndNative: Manage sprints, work items, and native time tracking compatible with Cloud and On-Premise instances.
integrations.instantSyncForCyclesIssuesAnd: Instant sync for cycles, issues, and project states with automatic workflow resolution.
integrations.trackMergeRequestsPipelinesAndNative: Track Merge Requests, pipelines, and native time logs through the GitLab REST API v4.
integrations.plugYourExistingToolsNeverBreak: Plug your existing tools. Never break your flow.
integrations.connectToTheIssueTrackersAnd: Connect to the issue trackers and version control platforms you already use. Mr. Tick aggregates them into a unified desktop cockpit.
integrations.haveAProprietaryTrackerOrCustom: Have a proprietary tracker or custom backend?
integrations.buildCustomTypescriptPluginsWithFull: Build custom TypeScript plugins with full access to local storage, UI theme bridges, and sync hooks.
integrations.builtOnTopOfARock: Built on top of a rock-solid, modern engineering stack

architecture.allYourStateLivesDirectlyOn: All your state lives directly on your disk in embedded local storage. Zero network latency.
architecture.noInternetConnectionNoProblemTimers: No internet connection? No problem. Timers run, context is saved, and tasks can be updated offline.
architecture.onceConnectedOurReconciliationEngineSeam: Once connected, our reconciliation engine seamlessly pushes time logs and updates remote trackers.
architecture.yourWorkLogsNeverTravelThrough: Your work logs never travel through third-party telemetry servers. Full export capability at any time.
architecture.yourProductivityShouldnTDependOn: Your productivity shouldn't depend on external servers.
architecture.whileWebSaasToolsSufferFrom: While web SaaS tools suffer from downtime, spinners, and lag, Mr. Tick is instant. Offline is the default, not an afterthought.
